item.title: 🌍 Meet Canopy Marketing… one UK trade contact for a whole portfolio of boutique luxury hotels, not a single property.
item.description:
🌍 Meet Canopy Marketing… one UK trade contact for a whole portfolio of boutique luxury hotels, not a single property.
They're the UK and Europe sales and marketing arm for 20-plus independent luxury hotels, resorts and villas, over 20 years in the sector. One enquiry instead of 20 supplier relationships to build.
✨ The portfolio spans the 15-hotel Myconian Collection on Mykonos, the newly reopened Don Carlos in Marbella, Santiburi and the Si brand across Thailand, and the Mia Collection in Vietnam… plus Dubai, the Maldives and beyond.
Ideal for:
🍽 Food-led clients … food and beverage is a standout across the Myconian Collection
❤️ Honeymoon and couples specialists … adults-leaning properties run deep
📍 Family and multi-gen briefs … kids' clubs, splash pads, private-pool residences
Book through your usual bed banks and tour operators, or enquire direct. Your choice of route.
Full spotlight on the website… link in the comments 🔗

item.title: ✨ Meet Caribtours… a luxury tour operator that has been looking after agents since 1979.
item.description:
✨ Meet Caribtours… a luxury tour operator that has been looking after agents since 1979.
This is the name for your considered, higher-spend enquiries. Five-star holidays across the Caribbean, Indian Ocean, Arabia, South Africa and Europe, with a reservations team whose tenure runs from 13 to 28 years… they have slept in the beds and eaten in the restaurants they sell.
💡 The extras are built in, not upsold: UK lounge passes as standard, private transfers included, and a dedicated concierge for helicopter transfers, private cookery classes and restaurant bookings.
Ideal for:
🏝 Honeymoon and anniversary couples wanting Barbados or the Maldives
👨‍👩‍👧 Families after a five-star all-inclusive
🚢 Cruise-and-stay clients (Seabourn, Silversea, SeaDream)
🇬🇷 Premium short-haul in Greece, now their 4th top-selling destination
They never undercut you, they are contactable 24/7, and European deposits start at £150pp.

item.title: 🌍 This week's Supplier Spotlight: Aranui Cruises... French Polynesia done the way your well-travelled clients keep asking for.
item.description:
🌍 This week's Supplier Spotlight: Aranui Cruises... French Polynesia done the way your well-travelled clients keep asking for.
It's a Polynesian family-owned shipping line running since 1954. The Aranui 5 is a working cargo-passenger ship: the front carries up to 3,000 tonnes of freight to islands with no airport, and the rear is fitted out to four-star-hotel standard.
Your client sails a genuine supply run, going ashore with English-speaking guides while the crew unloads.
13 days, 12 nights, round-trip from Tahiti, all-inclusive once on board.
Ideal for:
✈️ Repeat cruisers who've run out of "new" on the big lines
🧭 Soft-adventure clients who want remote access with a comfortable bed
📍 The client who's done Bora Bora and wants the real Marquesas (UNESCO-listed since 2024)
🧳 The 60-plus traveller, where a senior discount applies
Not a volume play... one considered, high-value booking.
Full spotlight on the website… link in the comments 🔗

item.title: Hummingbird Travel came into the JLT webinar to bust a few Maldives myths… and left us with a supplier worth a proper look for your premium book.
item.description:
Hummingbird Travel came into the JLT webinar to bust a few Maldives myths… and left us with a supplier worth a proper look for your premium book.
They're a trade-only DMC, family-run since 1988, and the largest luxury operator in the Maldives with 155+ vetted resort contracts. The bit that matters? They have their own staff on the ground in the Maldives, Sri Lanka, the Seychelles and London… not a bed bank. So when a seaplane's grounded or Malé airport is chaos, there's someone there to sort it.
✈️ Ideal for:
🌍 Honeymoon and celebration specialists
🏝 Multi-gen family agents (villa bed configs sorted by reservations)
🧭 Twin-centre builders pairing Sri Lanka with the Maldives
💭 Concierge and lifestyle agencies with VIP clients
One to note… off-season Maldives can save clients up to around 75% versus a high-end European summer.

item.title: Fresh supplier spotlight for you all 🚢
item.description:

Royal Caribbean's brand-new Legend of the Seas is now in service… the third Icon-class ship, and the first one ever to sail in Europe. If clients have been asking about "the big new one", this is her.
Why she's worth a spot in your book:
⚓ First Icon-class ship in Europe, with live inaugural buzz right now
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Built for multigen families: waterpark, kids' zones, adults-only Hideaway, 28 restaurants
